consensus_snapshot.notes: Forecasts are third-party opinions, not data. consensus_history.csv appends one row per period per run.
consensus_snapshot.source: Yahoo Finance analyst consensus (forward EPS / revenue, revisions, price targets) - a dated SNAPSHOT, not history

earnings_events.notes: reaction_date = first session whose close reflects the release (Oracle reports after 16:00 ET). eps_actual is the non-GAAP EPS as reported by Yahoo; revenue surprise is not available from free sources.
earnings_events.source: SEC EDGAR 8-K Item 2.02 acceptance timestamps + Yahoo Finance consensus EPS surprises

fundamentals_annual_xbrl.source: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts (us-gaap); quarters derived from 10-Q/10-K, first-filed values

fundamentals_quarterly.notes: USD in $ millions. avail_date = first session reflecting the release (point-in-time safe).
fundamentals_quarterly.source: SEC EDGAR XBRL + Oracle earnings releases (derived ratios computed in analytics/fundamentals.py)

fundamentals_quarterly_xbrl.notes: Q4 = FY - 9M YTD; share counts are averages (Q4 = 4*FY - sum(Q1..Q3)). 'filed' = first filing date.
fundamentals_quarterly_xbrl.source: SEC EDGAR XBRL companyfacts (us-gaap); quarters derived from 10-Q/10-K, first-filed values

ohlcv_ORCL.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance (auto_adjust=False; adj_close is dividend-adjusted)

peer_fundamentals.notes: Anchors for terminal capital intensity (net PP&E / revenue) and margin ranges; not a forecast.
peer_fundamentals.source: Yahoo Finance annual statements (MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, NVDA) - ~4 fiscal years each

press_release_kpis.notes: Cloud / IaaS / SaaS revenue in $bn (rounded to 0.1 by Oracle) and USD growth %. Unparsed items are NaN. Next-quarter guidance parsed only where the release states it.
press_release_kpis.source: Oracle earnings press releases (SEC EDGAR 8-K Exhibit 99.1), parsed with regex

prices_adj_close.notes: Benchmarks use total-return ETF proxies: SPY (S&P 500), QQQ (Nasdaq 100), SMH (semiconductors).
prices_adj_close.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance (auto_adjust=False; adj_close is dividend-adjusted)

prices_close.notes: Benchmarks use total-return ETF proxies: SPY (S&P 500), QQQ (Nasdaq 100), SMH (semiconductors).
prices_close.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance (auto_adjust=False; adj_close is dividend-adjusted)

prices_volume.notes: Benchmarks use total-return ETF proxies: SPY (S&P 500), QQQ (Nasdaq 100), SMH (semiconductors).
prices_volume.source: Yahoo Finance via yfinance (auto_adjust=False; adj_close is dividend-adjusted)

risk_free.notes: Annualised decimal rates, forward-filled to trading days. rf_3m is used for Sharpe/Sortino/alpha, rf_10y for the DCF.
risk_free.source: FRED (DGS3MO, DGS10) - Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

sec_companyfacts_raw.notes: Raw JSON as downloaded; every XBRL fact Oracle has filed (non-dimensional).
